# xattrintent

Pure-Go extended-attribute preservation policy for explicit copy intents. Use it to apply the qualified native name/intent rules on any supported operating system. It does not open files, copy values, grant permissions or replace the metadata carrier.

Use [hostdata](../README.md) for complete held/path lifecycle operations. The
[package migration guide](../../../docs/hostdata-packages.md) describes import
changes and the unchanged cross-platform qualification requirements.
